group.label: Instant Navigation
group.comment: While a shopper points at a link (or touches it), the browser loads the next page in the background, so the click opens it at once. Uses the Speculation Rules API: Chrome and Edge; other browsers ignore it and work as before. Pages mostly come from the page cache, so the extra load is small. Flush the page cache after changing these settings.

field.label: Mode
field.comment: Prerender: the page is loaded and rendered in the background, the click shows it at once. Prefetch: only its HTML is loaded, the click still renders it (lighter, a little slower).

field.label: When
field.comment: Moderate: after pointing at a link for about 0.2 s (a touch on phones). Conservative: when the click or touch starts.

field.label: Never Load Ahead
field.comment: One path per line, * as wildcard. Links with a query string (filters, sorting) and links marked data-no-instant are never loaded ahead either. Keep anything that changes something (cart, checkout, account, logout) here.
